name: AVIATAR Predictive Health Analytics
summary: Predicts component and system failures from full flight data and recommends actions that can flow into AMOS or Trax; Frontier added it in 2026.
paragraphs: Predicts component and system failures from full flight data and recommends actions that can flow into AMOS or Trax; Frontier added it in 2026.
whyItMatters: Turns unscheduled removals into planned ones on Airbus and Boeing fleets, independent of the OEM.
